What's new in 0.33.0 — Live TV subtitles made from the audio

• For channels that send no subtitles: turn on Settings > Live TV > Subtitles made from the audio. It asks first, then downloads about 110 MB once.
• While watching, hold OK, then Subtitles > Made from the audio (English). They stay on from channel to channel until you turn them off.
• Written on your TV as the programme plays. The audio never leaves it.
• In step with the speech: while subtitles show, the picture and sound run 3 seconds behind, so each line is ready as it's said.
• Remove Download in Settings frees the space again.
